_comment: CHRON canonical event store. Dates only — day counts are COMPUTED at render. Add an event with a real source or do not add it.
_prediction_schema: Falsifiable predictions: each event carries predictions[] with claim, expected_value, threshold, verifier (how to check), falsifier (what proves it wrong). A prediction that can only be 'did event happen' is not a prediction.

events.title: Belanjawan 2027 dibentang di Parlimen
events.note: Baris dividen PETRONAS dan subsidi bahan api jadi boleh dicek pada hari itu.

predictions.claim: PETRONAS dividen to federal government will be ≥ RM30b for FY2027
predictions.verifier: Check MOF budget speech or fiscal outlook report on budget day
predictions.human: Dividen PETRONAS kepada kerajaan untuk FY2027 ≥ RM30 bilion

predictions.claim: RON95 subsidy rationalisation will be announced or reaffirmed in budget speech
predictions.verifier: Read budget speech transcript, search for subsidi bahan api / RON95
predictions.falsifier: Budget speech makes no mention of fuel subsidy reform
predictions.human: Reformasi subsidi RON95 disebut atau ditegaskan dalam ucapan belanjawan

events.title: Harga minyak kuat kuasa 17-23 Sept tamat
events.note: Harga minggu seterusnya diumum sekitar tarikh ini.

predictions.claim: RON95 price for 24-30 Sept window will remain at or below RM2.05/litre
predictions.verifier: Check MOF weekly fuel price announcement on 23 Sept
predictions.human: Harga RON95 untuk 24–30 Sept kekal ≤ RM2.05/liter

predictions.claim: Brent crude will be in range USD65-75/bbl on 23 Sept (weekly avg)
predictions.verifier: Check Brent spot price via WEALTH capital_market on 23 Sept
predictions.human: Brent dalam julat USD65–75 setong pada 23 Sept

predictions.falsifier: No MSS terms received by OD1

events.title: Perlindungan elektrik 800 kWh tamat, revert ke 600 kWh
events.note: Bil Januari naik walaupun penggunaan tidak berubah.

predictions.human: Bil elektrik Jan 2027 untuk rumah yang guna 700 kWh/bulan ≥15% lebih tinggi dari Dis 2026

events.title: Tetingkap e-Invoice tanpa penalti tamat
events.note: Hari terakhir untuk regularisasi tanpa penalti.

predictions.verifier: Check LHDN announcements for SVDP extension in Q4 2027

events.title: BNM MPC: OPR unchanged at 2.75%
events.source: BNM MPC decision schedule 2026; Aug CPI 1.9% per DOSM
events.note: First calibration test from ChatGPT external witness. Binary, falsifiable, exact verify date. Continuous moderate inflation + strong growth → no immediate rate-cut need.

predictions.claim: BNM will keep the Overnight Policy Rate at 2.75% on 5 November 2026
predictions.verifier: BNM official press release after 5 Nov 2026 MPC meeting (3:00pm MYT)
predictions.falsifier: BNM announces OPR ≠ 2.75% (cut to 2.50% or hike to 3.00%)
predictions.human: BNM kekalkan OPR pada 2.75% pada 5 Nov 2026

events.title: Malaysia Sept 2026 CPI: 1.7–2.1% YoY
events.source: DOSM CPI release schedule; July CPI 1.8%, August 1.9%
events.note: Second calibration test. No interpretive ambiguity — binary pass/fail on bounds. Central estimate 1.9%.

predictions.claim: Malaysia September 2026 headline CPI inflation will be between 1.7% and 2.1% YoY inclusive
predictions.verifier: DOSM official CPI release on 19 Oct 2026 (~14:00 MYT)
predictions.human: Inflasi CPI September 2026 antara 1.7% dan 2.1% YoY

events.title: Malaysia Q3 2026 advance GDP: ≥5.0% YoY
events.source: DOSM advance GDP release schedule; Q2 2026 actual 6.0%, Q1 5.4% per BNM
events.note: Third calibration test. First to verify (16 Oct). Threshold 5.0% is conservative — below Q1 actual. If this passes, it strongly supports MY-001 (BNM hold).

predictions.claim: Malaysia Q3 2026 advance GDP growth will be at least 5.0% YoY
predictions.verifier: DOSM advance GDP estimate release on 16 Oct 2026 (~14:00 MYT)

_human_field: Optional `human`: the BM rendering of a prediction's machine claim, for surfaces read by humans. The machine `claim` stays canonical for verification; a surface that has no `human` rendering stays silent rather than printing the machine text.
